Name: (AT) Ginger Island Farm Buildings
Author: Yetiskies22
Description:
This is a Mod That I Had Commissioned for Ginger Island Themed Buildings, as I was surprised no one had made any before.

Comes With
Barn, Big Barn, and Deluxe Barn
Coop, Big Coop, and Deluxe Coop
Shed, Big Shed, and Deluxe Shed, Though that requires, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38430]More Upgrades by [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/207007068]Amichwan[/url]﻿
And Tiger Slime Coop

The Deluxe Shed is also available as an alternative texture for The Big Shed so you can still use it even if you don't have More Upgrades. I personally only Use The Sheds and Silos from the Mod since SVE adds Premium Coop and Barn.

Sprites and Coding Done By [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/PossiblyClown]FellowClown[/url], Please Check out Her Amazing Work on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39812]The Arcanian Exchange[/url].
